Sisram Medical

Medical Grade Wellness For Everyone

Sisram Medical, a global consumer wellness group, is deeply rooted in the global medical aesthetics industry for over two decades, specializing in harnessing natural energy sources for the treatment of aesthetics as well as medical clinical indications. The Sisram stamp represents years of expertise, knowledge and commitment to the highest standards of quality and connects all of the group’s brands under the same medical heritage umbrella.

Sisram’s products and services are featured in the leading surgical, medical and beauty clinics around the world, treating dozens of millions of consumers worldwide. Our products and treatments portfolio is vast and constantly expanding, ranging from hair removal, skin rejuvenation, Acne and Acne scars, body & face contouring, pigmentation & skin resurfacing, fat grafting, dermal facial fillers, skin tissue remodeling, injectables, personal care, aesthetic dentistry and more.
Learn More

For You. For Life.

Alma, a Sisram Medical company, is a world- leading provider of energy-based solutions for the surgical, medical aesthetics and beauty markets, delivering cutting edge technologies to our partners, professional customers and consumers.


Learn More

The science of self-care.

LMNT by Sisram Medical is a personal care brand, delivering the essence of wellness into your daily routine.  With over two decades of experience in the global medical aesthetics solutions industry, it is time for our technology to become available for all consumers who seek to look their best and be prepared for anything and everything.


Learn More

Your digital co-pilot

Copulla by Sisram Medical is an end-to-end digital dentistry service, challenging existing dentistry workflow by creating an ideal, assisted digital workflow. Copulla’s mission is to enable cost-effective and efficient measurement, design and production process for aesthetic dentistry treatments via a digital platform, covering all aspects from intra-oral scanning to final dental appliance delivery.


Learn More

Injectables

Excelling injectables therapy

As natural as the aging process is, most of us wish we could delay the signs of time... Recent innovations in the medical aesthetics industry bind energy-based devices with injectables therapy to treat multiple factors of aging from cause to symptoms. Sisram Medical offers practitioners and consumers a wholesome solution based on innovation, education, training, quality and safety for standalone injectables as well as combined treatments practices.
